instruction: Help me to install Mojave-dark theme from gnome-look.org and enable it on my GNOME desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing Mojave-dark theme from gnome-look.org and applying it to GNOME desktop. Evaluator checks if gtk-theme setting contains 'Mojave-dark' using gsettings command. Similar to original task but with different theme name.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses gsettings command to extract GTK theme setting, which is the appropriate method for checking GNOME theme configuration
check_list metric with regex pattern matching is suitable for detecting theme name in gsettings output
Expected value 'Mojave-dark' correctly matches the theme name specified in the instruction
Evaluator verifies theme is enabled, which implicitly confirms installation (cannot enable non-installed theme)
gsettings output format (e.g., 'Mojave-dark' with quotes) is handled correctly by regex search in check_list
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider escaping the hyphen in expected pattern to avoid potential regex interpretation issues: 'Mojave\-dark' (though current pattern works in practice)
For more robust verification, could add check that theme files exist in ~/.themes/ or /usr/share/themes/, though current approach is pragmatically sufficient
